Linux sandbox API with UID/GID switching, PID/TID lookup, and seccomp setup.

# Purpose
This header declares the Linux sandbox interface used to place a process into a restricted execution environment. It provides [`fd_sandbox_enter`](<#fd_sandbox_enter>) to clear the environment, verify file descriptors and groups, change user and group IDs, unshare namespaces, apply resource limits, drop capabilities, enable `no_new_privs`, apply Landlock rules, and install a seccomp-BPF filter. It also declares helper functions for checking whether `CAP_SYS_ADMIN` is needed, switching UID and GID for the calling thread, and reading the true PID and TID from the root PID namespace with [`fd_sandbox_getpid`](<#fd_sandbox_getpid>) and [`fd_sandbox_gettid`](<#fd_sandbox_gettid>).
# Function Declarations (Public API)

---
- `fd_sandbox_requires_cap_sys_admin`
- `fd_sandbox_enter`
- `fd_sandbox_switch_uid_gid`
- `fd_sandbox_getpid`
- `fd_sandbox_gettid`
